views: view1: แปลนโครงหลังคา 1:100 — steel trusses T1 + purlins (this file)
warnings: 'TRUSS T1' is printed on all seven grid lines 1-7, including the two gable lines. Each truss spans eave to eave A' to C'' (1.60 + 6.50 + 2.00 + 1.60 = 11.70, the chain printed on this sheet and on the truss detail S-08); it bears on the roof beams R2 / column heads on rows A and B and on the steel corridor posts on row C.

Purlins are drawn (dashed) along the length of the roof with the callout 'แปเหล็ก C-100x50x20x3.2มม @1.00-1.05ม'; no tick is printed to individual purlin lines, so they are recorded as one unmarked area entry rather than inventing grid lines.

Also printed, not structural members: 'แนวสันหลังคา' (ridge line), 'รางระบายน้ำฝนสังกะสี หนาไม่น้อยกว่า 0.23มม' along both eaves, roof drains 'RD.' with 'ท่อระบายน้ำฝนสังกะสี ด้านหลัง 4 จุด' / 'ด้านหน้า 2 จุด'.
A timber alternative of the same truss (โครงหลังคาไม้ TRUSS T1) is detailed on S-08; it is recorded in the truss section file, not as a second set of plan members.
